jobs.description:
TL;DR
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Security at Lovable, end-to-end, from conception through rollout. You'll make sure the millions of apps built on Lovable are safe, trustworthy, and secure by default, turning security from a checkbox into a genuine product differentiator.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we're looking for
8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role
Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about
Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable
Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisions

What you'll do
Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction
Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users
Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection
Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't
Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker
Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the company

About your application
Please submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the design and visual building experience at Lovable. You'll lead visual editing, content editing, design systems, and theming, all AI-first, making sure that what people build with Lovable is consistent, on-brand, and easy to experiment with.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. 8+ years in the software industry, with experience in product management or engineering leadership on design tools, visual editors, or creative platforms (Figma, Canva, Webflow, or similar)

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realize amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role
As Bid Centre Manager, you will play a central role in Saab's international Marketing & Sales activities. Working at the heart of major business opportunities, you will lead the daily operations of the Bid Centre and create the conditions for successful proposal development across multiple campaigns and customer opportunities.
The role is focused on coordinating and developing the overall bid capability and supporting bid teams throughout the organization.

You will work closely with Bid Managers, Proposal Managers, campaign teams and stakeholders across Saab, ensuring that resources, methods and tools are used effectively and that our bid teams are equipped to deliver high-quality proposals.
Your responsibility spans four main areas:
Bid Centre Coordination - Coordinating resources, priorities and activities across ongoing bids and campaigns.
Operational Excellence - Supporting the continuous development of methods, processes and tools that strengthen our bid capability.
Business Support - Providing guidance and support to bid teams and contributing to successful proposal delivery across the organization.
Security - Ensuring security plans, physical and digital environment are compliant with governing regulations.

Your profile
We are looking for a driven and structured professional who thrives in a complex international business environment. You enjoy creating clarity, bringing people together around a common objective and ensuring that activities move forward in an efficient and coordinated way.

To succeed in this role, we see that you:
Have experience of coordinating projects, bids or other complex business activities.
Have strong collaborative and communication skills.
Are comfortable working across organizational boundaries and engaging with a wide range of stakeholders.
Have excellent organizational skills and a structured, proactive way of working.

Enjoy improving ways of working and creating efficient processes.
Have a "doer" mindset and take ownership from idea to execution.
Are fluent in English and Swedish.

Have curiosity and openness to technological development, with an interest in AI-based tools and methods.

Additionally, the following skills are valued:
Strong communicative skills with ability to convey complex information clearly.
Understanding of risk management in complex business environments.
Aspirational mindset with potential to grow into other roles in sales.
Overall perspective with responsibility to coordinate bids and ensure all plans are up to date.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of
Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring mission, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 26,100 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Read more about us here

The opportunity  
We are expanding and looking for a Senior Project Engineer to join our growing global team. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, engineering, and delivery of climate systems within HVDC projects, ensuring the reliable operation of HVDC stations around the world, from deserts to arctic regions, both onshore and offshore. 
 
“At Hitachi Energy, the Climate System team plays a key role in ensuring the reliability and performance of HVDC stations across the globe. We are building a strong, multidisciplinary organization that combines deep technical competence with collaboration and innovation. As a Senior Project Engineer, you’ll be part of this journey. If you are motivated by engineering excellence and global impact, we would be happy to welcome you to our team” - Farshad Abbasi, Manager Climate System 
 This role is based in Ludvika, Sweden. 

How you’ll make an impact 
Perform the technical design and calculations of climate systems for HVDC converter stations, including reviewing designs, drawings, documentation, and technical specifications. 
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to ensure effective integration of climate systems within overall HVDC plant designs. 
Support all project phases—from tendering and conceptual design to detailed engineering, procurement, installation, and commissioning—ensuring quality and timely execution. 
Conduct design reviews to ensure compliance with customer requirements, ASHRAE standards, and internal guidelines. 
Assist with testing, verification, and performance validation during commissioning, including site inspections and on-site support. 
Translate customer needs into reliable and compliant climate system solutions. 
Contribute to continuous improvement efforts and mentor junior engineers to support technical development within the team. 

Your background 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Energy Systems, or a related field with a focus on heat transfer and fluid mechanics. 
Proven expertise in climate systems or HVAC equipment such as chillers, dehumidifiers, air handling units, and integrated monitoring and control sensors. 
Solid understanding of psychrometric charts, heat transfer (active/passive), flow diagrams, and control systems. 
Experience working on large-scale engineering projects is an advantage. 
You should ideally like working in a multicultural environment and be able to express yourself written and spoken in English. Swedish is considered an advantage. 

 
More about us  
We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.​  
Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ 
Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)​ 
Group life insurance and additional insurances.​ 
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank​ 
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)​ 
Health care and wellness allowance​ 
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ 
Psychological support program​​ 
Supplementary compensation for parental leave​ 
Various trainings and education supporting employee development ​ 
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally​ 
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks​ 

 
The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.​

Northmill Bank is a challenger bank at the intersection of technology and finance, committed to revolutionizing the way people manage and protect their financial well-being. We are creating a different kind of banking experience, digital yet personal.
Northmill Bank was founded in 2006 and has grown to over 250 employees in 3 countries and over 270 000 customers. We use the latest technology to develop safe, smart, and user-friendly products for our customers. They are the sole reason why we do what we do. We are a 100% cloud-based product company where technology is the driver to create smarter banking products.
Grab this opportunity to be a part of us and our journey!
About the role
As a Credit Analyst at Northmill, you will play a key role in finding the right balance between sustainable business growth and responsible risk management. You will work across the entire credit lifecycle, from new customer acquisition and loan origination to portfolio monitoring and collections.
Through data-driven analysis, you will identify opportunities to improve our credit policies, optimise portfolio performance and ensure that our lending strategies remain aligned with Northmill's risk appetite.
This is a hands-on and analytical role where your insights and recommendations will have a direct impact on business decisions. You will work closely with colleagues across Credit Risk, Data Science, Data Engineering, Product and Marketing, translating complex analyses into actionable recommendations.
You will report to the Head of Credit Risk for B2C.
Key responsibilities

Analyse credit performance and identify opportunities to improve Northmill's credit policies and lending strategies.

Continuously monitor lending portfolios throughout the credit lifecycle, identifying trends, deviations and potential risks.

Develop data-driven recommendations and present proposals to the Credit Committee.

Follow up on implemented changes and evaluate their impact on portfolio performance and profitability.

Collaborate with Data Scientists on the development and ongoing improvement of credit models.

Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure data infrastructure and management support effective credit analysis.

Partner with Product and Marketing to balance lending growth, revenue generation and credit risk.

Represent the Credit function in cross-functional projects and drive the implementation of approved initiatives.

Who we are looking for
We are looking for someone with a strong analytical mindset, a genuine curiosity for understanding data and business performance, and the ability to turn insights into meaningful actions.
You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your analyses and making recommendations even when information is not always complete. You also enjoy collaborating with different stakeholders and can communicate complex analytical findings in a clear and accessible way.
We believe you have:

A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.

Experience as a Credit Analyst, Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.

Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail.

Experience working with SQL and Snowflake for data querying and manipulation.

Advanced Excel skills.

Experience using AI tools such as Claude and/or Cursor in your day-to-day analytical work.

Fluency in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing.

What we offer

A fantastic office in a prime Stockholm location with great spaces and views

An independent role with the opportunity to make a real impact

Great opportunities for professional development

Health - 5 000 kr wellness allowance

Conference abroad every other year

Breakfast and fruits every day, as well as "holy fika” each Friday

Regular after work and celebrated successes at the office

Apply today and be a part of Northmill!

Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

jobs.occupation: Senior Embedded Audio Software Developer  Automotive
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Embedded Audio Software Developer to join our Automotive Product Team, part of Engineering within Dirac's R&D organization. If you're an experienced embedded developer who wants to work with cutting-edge audio technology and help shape how the cars of tomorrow sound, this role is for you.
What Dirac offers you
At Dirac, you'll work in an entrepreneurial environment with people who are passionate about inventing the future of sound. You'll join a collaborative agile team that values quality, continuous improvement and having fun along the way.
Automotive is a key strategic focus for Dirac, and our ambition is to become number one in automotive audio. In this role, you'll play a central part in making that happen.
Your role
You'll develop, test and maintain our Intelligent Audio Platform (IAP), a scalable software platform that brings our audio technology to automotive DSPs and SoCs for in-car audio experiences. You'll work closely with our algorithm team and other software teams in Sweden, Denmark and India.
Your main responsibilities include:
Developing, integrating and testing new audio processing blocks in the IAP
Maintaining and improving the IAP architecture for scalability, configurability and ease of integration in customer programs
Providing 2nd-line technical support to our automotive customer programs
Driving improvements to our development processes and ways of working

Your initial focus will be to build a deep understanding of our IAP architecture and the automotive business context, so you can work independently on prioritized features and improvements. Longer term, you'll take ownership of features and epics from start to finish, with a clear path to a technical lead role.
Who you are
You're a team player who believes the best results come from "we" rather than "me". You take ownership, know how to balance risk, quality and speed, and enjoy sharing your knowledge with others.
Must have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, mathematics, or electronics
At least 5 years of professional software development experience, a significant part of it in embedded systems
Strong embedded C skills, including real-time and performance-critical code
Experience designing scalable, configurable software platforms or frameworks
Working knowledge of C++, Python and CMake
Solid engineering practices such as code reviews, test-driven development, CI and test automation
Strong communication skills in English

It is a plus if you have:
Hands-on experience with DSP (Digital Signal Processing), ideally on embedded DSP architectures and/or in the audio domain
Experience in developing cross platform libraries that target multiple different architectures
Experience with application development frameworks such as Qt
Experience from a structured, regulated development environment (e.g., Automotive SPICE or medical devices)
Experience with embedded operating systems such as an RTOS, embedded Linux, QNX or Android Automotive
A background in audio, e.g., acoustics, audio software or audio hardware

About Dirac
Dirac is one of Sweden's fastest-growing audio tech companies, known for best-in-class technology and a prestigious customer base that includes many of the world's most reputable brands. We are a global company with headquarters in Uppsala, Sweden, R&D facilities in Copenhagen, Denmark, and Bangalore, India, and representation in Greater China, Germany, Japan, Korea, and the United States. Read more at https://www.dirac.com/.
Location, travel, and start date
This is a permanent, full-time, office-based position at our headquarters in central Uppsala, with some travel included. Start date: as soon as possible.
Questions and application
For questions about the role, contact hiring manager Allan Westphal at allan.westphal@dirac.com. 
Selection is ongoing, so apply as soon as possible. We look forward to your application!

What you'll do:
The CERN ATLAS Team plays a major role in the construction of the future silicon ATLAS Inner Tracker (ITk). In particular, the CERN Detector Technologies (DT) team focuses on the realisation of the Pixel Outer Barrel for the ITk. Our activities include the design, prototyping and assembly of the support structures and tooling as well as the final detector integration, installation and testing. As a mechanical/electromechanical technician in the CERN-DT Team, you will join the Engineering Office Section (EP-DT-EO) and work closely with personnel from the ATLAS Group (EP-ATL) and the Technical Coordination Team of the ATLAS Experiment in the design and construction of the ATLAS ITk Pixel Outer Barrel.

Your responsibilities:
- Participate in the production, testing and installation of the Pixel Outer System services and their support structures (e.g. trolleys).
- Support the design, manufacturing and installation of temporary services and infrastructure for testing during the integration of the Pixel Detector.
- Participate hands-on in the integration of the Pixel Outer System and its insertion into ITk in the SR1 cleanroom, contributing to the development and fabrication of the corresponding tooling.
- Participate in the ITk installation in the ATLAS cavern, supporting preparation of Pixel services for installation as well as connections after insertion.
- Document manufacturing and installation procedures as well QC information of tools and production parts to ensure traceability.

Your profile:
- Demonstrated experience in conventional precision machining of metallic and non-metallic parts, using both conventional and non-conventional methods.
- Good understanding of mechanical and electrical drawings, including geometrical tolerance specifications.
- Demonstrated experience in the assembly of complex, high precision mechanical systems with high quality standards.
- Proven experience in manufacturing and installation of cable bundles and harnesses.
- Proven experience with of structural joining techniques, particularly adhesive bonding and orbital welding.
- Previous experience in computer numerically controlled (CNC) machines would be considered an asset.
- Experience in the use of CAD software (ideally Catia V5) for the 2D and 3D modelling would be considered an asset.
- Previous experience in CAD-CAM programming (preferably using WORKNC) would be considered an asset.
- Higher technical diploma or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Precision Mechanics or a related field.

Your skills:
- Manufacturing of mechanical parts.
- Knowledge and application of joining techniques, glueing, welding.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models (ISO dimensioning, tolerancing).
- Programming and use of CNC machine-tools and machining centres.
- Precision assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.
- Delivers high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements; works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities. At the same time, works well autonomously, taking on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach, understanding the value of adopting generic rather than 'gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 36
Grade range: 3-4
Benchmark job: 300090 - Mechanical Technician
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

Engineering Director - Infrastructure & Security
This role has strategic and operational responsibilities for the engineering function. Engineering works side-by-side with our product colleagues in the product operating model. This role has a domain focus on infrastructure, security, and compliance. You will collaborate closely with your peer director in with a product domain focus. You are laying the secure, golden path. They are using that path to build and operate the products we deliver to our customers. 
This role reports to the Chief Technology Office (CTO). 
Who you are 

10+ years of engineering leadership experience with hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, security, and compliance. 

You are an effective communicator and motivator at all levels of an organisation. 

You have demonstrated experience operating as an effective leader in a remote first environment. We have engineers in Sweden, America, and India today. 

You are resilient and resourceful in face of ambiguity and thrive on change. 

You communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences, adapting your message to the audience and context. 

You can explain technical priorities, trade-offs, risks and decisions in terms of that support business decisions. 

You have a track record of building capable, high-performing teams and helping people grow through clear expectations, feedback and coaching. 
The role You will build and maintain a capable engineering organisation to deliver on business goals.
Strategic Planning. You maintain a roadmap that keeps our infrastructure modern and security posture strong. 
Security & Compliance. You develop strategies to meet security goals and implement them. You are the engineering lead for compliance initiatives, including annual audits. 
Operational Oversight. You have operational oversight of infrastructure and security based on metrics and KPIs. You embrace continuous improvement and use this as opportunities to inform your strategic roadmap. 
Team Leadership. You lead the infrastructure teams. Your mission is to make them high performing and foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence. 
Staffing. Develop and maintain talent acquisition partners and strategies to meet staffing objectives.

Communication. Make sure teams understand the strategy, priorities, decisions, and expected outcomes. Communicate changes and decisions clearly, explain the rationale, and create opportunities for questions and feedback. Establish communication practices that keep remote teams informed and connected across location and time zones. Represent Product Engineering in leadership discussions, clearly explain progress, capacity, risks, trade-offs and recommendations.
What do we offer you? We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations. · Competitive salary and benefits · Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important. · Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.
Want to join our crew? Sounds like a great fit for you? You’ll find more fun facts about our Noders (that’s what we call ourselves) and our culture on our website. Kindly apply for this position through the “apply” button with your CV and cover letter in English as soon as possible. We are not able to accept applications via email. Please note that selections will be running continuously so don’t wait to apply!

jobs.occupation: Application Consultant to our Customer Success team
jobs.description:
Do you want to work closely with customers in the fitness industry and help them maximize the value of our market-leading business management platform? Do you enjoy a role where you combine project management, consulting, and customer interaction? Then you could be the person we’re looking for.
We are currently looking for several Application Consultants to join BRP Systems at one of our offices in Sweden (Linköping) or Norway (Asker).
We welcome different profiles – perhaps you have a strong technical background and enjoy system configuration and problem-solving, or maybe you’re motivated by leading customers through larger implementation projects in a project management role. Regardless of your focus, you will become part of our international Customer Success team, working alongside colleagues in Sweden, Denmark, Norway, and Finland.
About the Role
As an Application Consultant, you will work closely with both new and existing customers to ensure they achieve the greatest possible business value from our solutions.
Your responsibilities can include:
Project management and/or delivery of onboarding and implementation projects
System configuration, installation, and setup
Advising customers on system design and business processes
Analyzing customer requirements and translating them into effective solutions
Implementing new features and managing system upgrades
Working with integrations and third-party solutions
Delivering training sessions for customers and colleagues
Providing ongoing consulting services and handling change requests for existing customers

As an Application Consultant, you will have the opportunity to focus on shorter consulting assignments, quickly helping customers with system changes, configuration, and advisory services. You might also manage larger implementation projects, acting as project manager and serving as the customer’s primary point of contact throughout the onboarding process. Both areas require a high level of professionalism, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently.
Who We’re Looking For
We believe you’ll thrive in a growing company where the pace is high and change is a natural part of everyday work. You enjoy working closely with customers and are motivated by solving problems, working in a structured way, and building long-term relationships.
You are proactive, take ownership of your work, and are skilled at planning and balancing the needs and expectations of multiple stakeholders.
To succeed in this role, we believe you:
Have experience working in a customer-facing, consultative role
Learn and understand complex systems and business processes quickly
Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Communicate clearly and build trust with both customers and colleagues
Take ownership of your assignments and drive them forward in a structured manner

We would also like you to have:
A bachelor’s degree in Economics, IT, Engineering, Business, or equivalent experience
Strong IT skills
Fluency in English and in Swedish or Norwegian, both written and spoken

Experience with software implementations, project management, ERP or business management systems, SaaS solutions, or system integrations is considered an advantage. However, we place great emphasis on your personality, motivation, and willingness to learn.
Experience in the fitness industry, particularly in a role such as system administrator or similar, is highly valued.
What We Offer
At BRP Systems, you’ll work alongside engaged and knowledgeable colleagues on products that contribute to people’s health and well-being. You’ll become part of an international company with customers and colleagues across several countries, offering excellent opportunities to develop your technical expertise, consulting skills, and project management capabilities.
Join us on an exciting growth journey with the market leader in management solutions for the fitness industry!

UIG keeps growing, time to join UIG!
About us!
Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.
With a growing collection of restaurant brands, including Basta, Florentine, Trattoria Giorgio's, Lola Maria, and Villa Valentina, we're building something exciting across Europe.

This is a hands-on role with real responsibility. You will oversee accounting across approximately 20 Swedish entities, manage the monthly close and help strengthen the processes and systems that support our continued growth.

Take end-to-end ownership of accounting across our Swedish entities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and bank reconciliations.

Lead accurate and timely monthly, quarterly and year-end closing, including accruals, reconciliations and intercompany balances.

Prepare reliable internal and statutory reporting, providing clear financial information to colleagues across the business.

Ensure compliance with Swedish accounting standards, including K2 and K3, as well as relevant VAT, tax and reporting requirements.

Coordinate the Swedish audit process, preparing documentation and acting as the main contact for auditors and external advisers.

Strengthen internal controls and standardise accounting processes across the group, identifying risks or discrepancies early.

Improve and automate financial processes using Fortnox, digital tools and AI, while supporting the introduction of future finance systems.You'll thrive in this role if you 

You'll thrive in this role if you 
At least four years of hands-on accounting experience, ideally within a multi-entity group, scale-up or similarly fast-moving environment.

Strong knowledge of Swedish accounting regulations, K2 and K3, monthly closing and year-end reporting.

Solid experience across the full accounting cycle, including AP, AR, GL, reconciliations, accruals and statutory reporting.

Confidence using Fortnox and Excel, with an interest in new systems, automation and AI-supported ways of working.

The ability to manage several entities and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Fluency in Swedish and English, with the ability to explain financial information clearly to both finance and non-finance colleagues.

A proactive and hands-on approach—you take ownership, build structure and look for solutions when processes can be improved.

Our culture and values
We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Excellence, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.
What do we offer? 
Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

Build your career across multiple brands, functions and countries.

Work alongside talented people who are passionate about hospitality and growth.

International career and development opportunities.

The chance to influence how we work as the group continues to expand.

A collaborative, entrepreneurial and international office environment.

Employee discounts across UIG restaurants.

Referral bonus scheme.

Great colleagues—and quite possibly friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

teknisk dokumentation

produktutveckling

underhålls-, reparations-, test- eller felsökningsinstruktioner

Simplified Technical English

översättningshantering

Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop eller Excel

jobs.occupation: Experienced Fiber Technicians at Optic Tunnels
jobs.description:
Optic Tunnels is a new Swedish provider of data communication and AI services for demanding organizations – services produced on truly dedicated infrastructure, all the way down into the ground. To deliver them, we are building an entirely new, independent fiber backbone network between the Nordic capital regions, with strict requirements for security and performance at every step. Our services are launched step by step as the network grows, for customers along the entire route – not only between the endpoints. The network build-out is well underway, initially focused on Greater Stockholm, the Mälaren Valley, Dalarna and Skåne, and we are now looking for experienced fiber technicians who want to join us on the journey.
The role
As a fiber technician at Optic Tunnels, you will work with fiber installation and high-precision fusion splicing, as well as measurement and documentation. You will work closely with the civil works, follow each route from trench to completed connection, and take part alongside our subcontractors when the fiber cables are installed in the ducts.
The work is largely in the field along our backbone network, but also in our own small data centers along the routes and at end-customer premises. This means flexible, mobile working days with a high degree of responsibility for planning your own work.
A strategic capability we are building in-house
While Optic Tunnels procures most of the network build-out from external contractors, all fiber splicing, measurement and documentation is carried out by our own staff. This is to ensure maximum control and security in the most sensitive parts of the network.
Measurements and documentation of splice quality and the optical properties of the fiber matter more to us than to most. The measurement data is used not only to verify that the fiber and the splice meet specification at the moment of testing, but also as a reference for detecting anomalies and intrusion attempts throughout the fiber's lifetime. This is a central part of our security offering, which is why careful measurement and impeccable documentation are as important as the fiber and the splices themselves.
What we are looking for
•      Documented experience as a fiber technician on backbone networks
•      A category B driver's license
•      The right to work in Sweden
•      Good computer skills and experience working with documentation
•      Fluent spoken and written English, the language of all our technical documentation. Working knowledge of Swedish is a plus.
You are orderly and meticulous, and you see documentation as a critical part of the work, not an add-on to it. You enjoy planning your own work and taking responsibility for it.
Terms
Location: Stockholm. The work involves travel and work throughout Optic Tunnels' network.
Extent: Full-time
Type of employment: Permanent, following an initial probationary period
Start: By agreement. Positions are filled on a rolling basis.
Working hours: The work is mainly carried out during daytime. Some tasks, such as planned maintenance within scheduled maintenance windows, may be carried out at other times. Around-the-clock on-call duty for repairing infrequent network faults is included on a rotating schedule, with compensation under the applicable agreement.
Applications and questions
Send a description of yourself and your experience as a fiber technician – the types of networks and projects you have worked on, and your responsibilities in them – together with details of your references, to jobs@optictunnels.com. We will only contact your references once we have agreed with you to do so. Questions about the position are welcome at the same address. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
Read more about Optic Tunnels at www.optictunnels.com.

At Galderma, we advance dermatology for every skin story. As the category leader in dermatology, we bring together science, innovation and people who are passionate about making a meaningful difference for patients around the world.

Perform microbiological analyses according to approved methods, SOPs and quality standards.
Review, evaluate and document analytical results in accordance with established procedures.
Support routine quality control activities within the microbiology laboratory.
Ensure laboratory documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner.
Participate in investigations, deviation management and root cause analyses.
Support method validations, change controls and continuous improvement activities.
Review and update laboratory documentation and work instructions as required.

You collaborate well with others, communicate clearly and take responsibility for delivering high-quality work.

Experience working in a laboratory environment within a regulated industry.
Knowledge of GMP and quality requirements.
Experience with microbiological testing or related laboratory activities.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.

 
Preferred Experience
Experience working within Quality Control.
Experience with environmental monitoring or environmental sampling.
Knowledge of microbiological laboratory techniques and quality systems.
Experience supporting investigations, deviations or change controls.

 
Location and information 
This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. We therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Odlings- och produktionsledare på The Culinary Farm
jobs.description:
Market Garden Production Manager 
Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden · March–November 2027 

We are looking for an experienced grower to take responsibility for the day-to-day production of The Culinary Farm starting in 2027.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who enjoys the pace, responsibility and problem-solving that comes with running a productive market garden.
About us 
Nominated as one of the Top 50 Farms in Europe, The Culinary Farm is a small-scale, diversified market garden in the heart of Skåne, southern Sweden
We grow a wide range of seasonal vegetables using agroecological principles, with a strong focus on flavour and quality. Our produce is grown primarily for chefs and our veggie-bag members in Malmö, Lund and Höör.
The farm also serves as an educational platform for Market Gardening in the Nordics.
Each season, we welcome 10–15 interns from around the world who join us for an immersive training in human-scale regenerative agriculture. 
The role 
As Market Garden Production Manager, you will be responsible for turning the seasonal crop plan into an efficient day-to-day operation, taking charge of all aspects of our production from seed to harvest.
You will: 
Plan weekly and daily production priorities.
Lead, organise and work alongside our interns.
Stay on top of sowing, planting, cultivation, irrigation and harvest.
Maintain high standards of quality and efficiency.
Identify bottlenecks and improve workflows.
Keep essential production and harvest records.
Ensure tools, irrigation systems, machinery and infrastructure are functioning properly.
How you work matters 
We are looking for someone who:
Is physically fit and enjoys working outside in all weather conditions Works efficiently and with purpose.
Is highly organised and strong at prioritising.
Sees both the immediate task and the bigger production picture. Takes initiative and solves problems independently.
Communicates clearly and leads by example.
Is self-motivated and also motivates others.
Creates structure, energy and a strong working pace within the team. Enjoys teaching and helping others develop their skills
Genuinely enjoys the intensity and variation of market gardening.
Experience 
You should have:
At least 1–2 full seasons of commercial vegetable-growing experience.
Experience with small-scale diversified vegetable production or Market Gardening. Knowledge of soil health, crop management and protection against pests & diseases. Experience leading, supervising or organising others.
Good communication skills in English.
A valid driving licence.
The legal right to work and live in Sweden.
Relevant horticultural or agricultural education is an advantage, but not required. Swedish is a plus, not a requirement.
What we offer 
The opportunity to lead in an established and ambitious market garden.
Work in an international team of young, passionate and driven change-makers
A role within our wider educational work around Market Gardening and human-scale food production in the Nordics.
A nice sun-kissed farmer’s tan
We work hard and maintain high standards, but we also want the farm to be a place where people enjoy working, learning and developing together.
Practical details
Position: Market Garden Production Manager
Location: Hallaröd, Skåne, Sweden
E
mployment: 

Full-time seasonal position
Season: March–November 2027
Working hours: 08:00–17:00, including a one-hour lunch break Start: March 2027
Salary: To be negotiated based on experience
Application Process
 Apply via our form: https://tmxggetk6he.typeform.com/to/tiflhp1H
 Applications are open to candidates across Europe.
Complete our online application form by October 15, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.
Selected candidates will be invited for an interview, followed by a practical recruitment day on the farm for finalists.
